title: 3EN Agent safe config patch simulation
description: Simulate a real configuration change on a harmless local test file: create baseline config, back it up, apply a patch, validate exact expected values, and keep rollback ready.
backup: $Dir='C:\3EN-Agent\sandbox'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Dir | Out-Null; $Cfg=Join-Path $Dir 'service.conf'; if(-not (Test-Path $Cfg)){ @('mode=baseline','enabled=false','threshold=10') | Set-Content -Path $Cfg -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host 'Created baseline config.' }; Copy-Item $Cfg "$Cfg.bak" -Force; Write-Host "Backup created: $Cfg.bak"
test: $Cfg='C:\3EN-Agent\sandbox\service.conf'; $lines=Get-Content $Cfg; $required=@('mode=agent-tested','enabled=true','threshold=42'); foreach($r in $required){ if($lines -notcontains $r){ throw "Validation failed: missing $r" } }; if($lines.Count -ne 3){ throw "Validation failed: expected 3 lines, got $($lines.Count)" }; Write-Host 'CONFIG VALIDATION PASS'; Get-Content $Cfg
rollback: $Cfg='C:\3EN-Agent\sandbox\service.conf'; $Bak="$Cfg.bak"; if(Test-Path $Bak){ Copy-Item $Bak $Cfg -Force; Write-Host 'Rollback restored original config.'; Get-Content $Cfg } else { throw 'Rollback backup not found.' }
